item.title: Salvation Army Augusta spreads gifts and Christmas cheer during its Angel Tree Distribution Day
item.description: A line of cars down Tate Street wrapped through the parking lot at the building of what was Terrace Manor Elementary School, Thursday morning, as families stopped by to pick up Christmas gifts for their children via the Salvation Army’s annual Angel Tree campaign. item.title: Drunk North Augusta man kidnaps 2-year-old daughter, drives to Tennessee
item.description: Richmond County authorities have custody of a North Augusta man accused of beating up his child’s mother, abducting their daughter and taking her to Tennessee. The post Drunk North Augusta man kidnaps 2-year-old daughter, drives to Tennessee appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Justice Department sues for release of Georgia voter data
item.description: The names, birth dates, addresses, driver’s license numbers and partial Social Security numbers of roughly eight million Georgia voters may soon be turned over to the U.S. Department of Justice.
